gbifID.description: Unique global occurrence identifier assigned by GBIF for each record.

datasetKey.description: Unique dataset identifier linking all records to the same occurrence dataset.

family.description: Family classification of the plant, consistently Asteraceae.

species.description: Species name of the recorded plant, consistently Nabalus hastatus.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet data absent for all records.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Original authorship citation for the scientific name as recorded in source data.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: State or province of occurrence, using Canadian provinces and US states.

occurrenceStatus.description: Occurrence status indicating that the species was observed at the site.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of coordinates in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision data missing for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation of observation site in meters above sea level.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation measurement accuracy is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: No depth measurements recorded for any occurrence.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth measurement accuracy is unavailable for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation date and time of each record.

speciesKey.description: Uniform taxonomic identifier for Nabalus hastatus occurrence records.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier, consistently iNaturalist for all records.

collectionCode.description: Dataset collection identifier consistently set to “Observations” for all records.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each Nabalus hastatus occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: No data recorded for this field.

dateIdentified.description: Identification timestamp of each occurrence record, ranging from July 2025 to June 2026.

rightsHolder.description: Names of individuals or organizations holding rights to the occurrence records.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each Nabalus hastatus occurrence.

typeStatus.description: Type status information is unavailable for all records.
